info.title: Trait Engineer API
info.description: Track psychological change targets and log evidence against them. All `/v1` routes need a session cookie, a session bearer token, or a personal access token (`Authorization: Bearer te_pat_...`).

Bearer.description: Personal access token (`te_pat_...`) or a session token

title.example: Default to action rather than over-planning

oldPattern.example: Rewrite proposals three times before sending

why.example: Momentum matters more than polish for me

currentStreakDays.description: Consecutive days with an entry, ending today (or yesterday if nothing logged yet today)

config.description: Validated by the tool type's configSchema

name.description: Defaults to the tool type's display name

payload.description: Validated by the tool type's payloadSchema

occurredAt.description: When it happened; defaults to now

clientId.description: Client-generated UUID; repeating a create with the same clientId is safe

rrule.description: RFC 5545 RRULE compiled from the schedule (read-only)

timezone.description: Defaults to the user's time zone

token.description: Plaintext token. Shown once; store it now.

email.description: Owner's email (only returned to the authenticated owner)

scopes.description: Scopes of the credential used for this request

Export.description: Everything for the user. Never includes credentials or the email.

delete.description: Change targets are never hard-deleted: DELETE sets status to `archived`.

get.summary: Tool summaries and totals for a change target

post.summary: Attach a tool to a change target
post.description: `config` is validated against the tool type's config schema; unknown types are rejected.

patch.summary: Update a tool (partial; config is merged and revalidated)

post.description: `payload` is validated against the tool type's payload schema. Repeating a request with the same `clientId` returns the existing entry with status 200 instead of creating a duplicate.

patch.summary: Update an entry (payload is merged and revalidated)

post.summary: Create a reminder from a schedule preset

patch.summary: Update a reminder (recomputes the next fire time)

post.summary: Send this reminder to all active devices now
Register or refresh a push device (upsert by Expo push token)

delete.summary: Stop sending pushes to a device

get.summary: List personal access tokens (never includes the token value)

post.description: The plaintext `token` is returned once. Tokens cannot create other tokens; use a signed-in session.

patch.summary: Update time zone or display name
